projects.subtitle: iO Academy Project 3: JavaScript Game
projects.description:
My first group project at iO Academy - Build a maze game using HTML/CSS/JS.
Move your mouse cursor to the end of the dog without touching the sides or any obstacles.

projects.title: iO Academy Finance Calculator

projects.title: iO Academy Online Aptitude Test

projects.description:
My second group project at iO Academy. We were tasked with continuing to develop an online aptitude test app for Mayden Academy to use in admissions.
We were given an existing frontend codebase to work with that had been developed by previous cohorts.

projects.title: Top Cat!
